title: Figures 67-68: Tic Tac CFD Mach number at 100 mph and pressure at 200 mph
description: Two color CFD contour plots of the capsule-shaped "Tic Tac" body at 1/6 scale with numeric color legends. Captions read "Figure 67. Tic Tac Mach Number at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 100 mph with Subsonic Inlet and Subsonic Outlet" (low-speed wake behind the body) and "Figure 68. Tic Tac Pressure at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 200 mph with Subsonic Inlet and Subsonic Outlet" (high pressure at the nose, in Pa). Attachment II, page 117 of the BAASS report.
